Explore Loan Services

Loan Service

Small & Project Loans

Financing for individuals, businesses and joint ventures with an ongoing business or a viable, employment-generating project.

  • All Services
  • Microcredit
  • Small & Project Loans
  • Hire Purchase
  • Wholesale Lending

Small and project loans may be applied for by individuals, corporate entities, groups, associations or cooperatives seeking a facility for a joint or common purpose.

The programme is designed for start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible financing to grow and expand their operations across Ghana.

MASLOC's small loans support start-ups and small businesses — a critical financial gap in economic participation for Ghanaian entrepreneurs at every scale.

Eligibility

Published eligibility criteria, as stated by MASLOC:

  • Applicant must be 18–65 years and of sound mind.
  • Must have an ongoing business venture or project.
  • Must have sound knowledge and considerable experience in the business or project.
  • Start-up projects or businesses must be viable and capable of generating employment.
  • Applicants with an ongoing economic activity, venture or project have an added advantage.

How to Apply

Full eligibility criteria, required documentation and application guidance are available from any MASLOC regional office or the Accra Head Office.

What is not published

Interest rates, loan amounts, repayment terms, approval timelines and document checklists are not published on MASLOC's official website. This site does not estimate them. Confirm current terms directly with MASLOC before making commitments.
